coverage_note: Katy ISD 2024–25: 65 searchable lower-grade profiles and 64 separate Math, ELA and paired Combined comparisons. Harris retains original missing Math and ELA outcomes and history gaps. All 81 CCD records, 79 operational schools and 77 native campuses remain in complete linked source evidence. Miller and Project Tyke lack native records; no name matching, zero fill or CCD income backfill repairs them. Individual October 2024 economic status uses own enrollment and differs from the accountability-tested population. Original whole-percent rates include documented STAAR, Spanish, Alternate 2 and applicable EOC scope. Valid-score counts and the ten-scored floor are uncertified; all sampling variances and intervals are unavailable. One year only; programs, admissions, providers, school coordinates and district boundaries remain unknown.

income_definition.definition: Individual October 25, 2024 PEIMS economic status uses each school’s own CPNTECOC economically disadvantaged count divided by its own CPNTALLC enrollment denominator covering all enrolled EE–12. CPETALLC membership is a separate administrative measure and never supplies that denominator. State codes 01/02/99 include free/reduced meal eligibility or other public assistance; CPNTECOC plus CPNTNEDC and native tenth-percent CPNTECOP display reconcile. This broader state-specific proxy differs from uniform FRPL, household income and the tested accountability subset. CEP requires individual direct certification and annual local income surveys; universal meals do not classify all children. Provision 2 may retain base-year eligibility for continuously enrolled students. Missing surveys may yield code 00; identification coverage and undercount are unknown. The January 16, 2025 resubmission extension requires enrollment and eligibility on October 25, 2024, without another-year backfill.

details: Katy ISD independent 2024–25 original published-rate grade-school models use exact CCD LEA 4825170 / TX-101914 / TAPR 101914. All 65 positive native enrolled grades 3–8 and explicit-zero grades 9–12 profiles remain searchable. Harris 101914033 retains both original subject masks, leaving 64 observations in each separate Math, ELA and own Combined model. Own CPNTALLC enrollment supplies the individual income denominator; CPETALLC membership remains separate. Miller 101914004 and Project Tyke 101914135 lack native records and stay outside. Valid-score counts, the ten-valid-scored floor, variances and sampling intervals remain unavailable; high, mixed, Future and unmatched populations stay separate.

Separate unweighted district OLS retains all 64 eligible schools per model and 192 explicit deleted-school fits. Combined independently fits equally weighted original Math and ELA rates with its own scales and externally studentized residuals; subject scores are never averaged. Filters never refit models. Associations do not establish causal school effectiveness or overall quality.

Exact same-year original NCES and native identities, complete enrolled grade counts, precise individual economic status and original published rates establish the population. Counts, school types, reference labels, influence and diagnostics never select model membership.
Original published whole percentages are used directly. Grade percentages and unverified count-ratio precision never replace them.

Individual October 25, 2024 PEIMS economic status uses each school’s own CPNTECOC count divided by CPNTALLC enrollment for all enrolled EE–12. CPETALLC membership remains a separate administrative measure. Codes 01/02/99 include individual free/reduced eligibility or other public assistance; this broader state-specific proxy differs from uniform household-income FRPL and the tested accountability subset.

CEP requires individual certification and local income surveys; universal meals do not classify all pupils. Provision 2 base-year continuity and missing surveys may limit identification. The January 16, 2025 extension retains October 25 eligibility and enrollment; another-year income is never substituted.

Original All Students TAPR enrolled grades 3–8 Including EOC rates cover Meets Grade Level or Above. STAAR with/without accommodations, Spanish STAAR, Alternate 2 and applicable Algebra I / English I–II EOC remain documented mixtures. TPRS all-testers, participation and both-subject passing are separate.

Native CPNTALLC enrollment totals 96,098, while PEIMS CPETALLC membership totals 95,919 and differs at 48 campuses. CCD district and operational membership is 96,111; Project Tyke’s unjoined 13-pupil record remains separate evidence. Differences do not establish individual causes or tested denominators.

Harris 101914033 / NCES 482517008823 retains positive lower-grade enrollment and own income, with both original subject masks. Miller 101914004 / NCES 482517008625 and Project Tyke 101914135 / NCES 482517008629 lack native data; no name, suffix or CCD backfill supplies income or outcomes.

All valid-score counts, sampling variances and interval endpoints remain null modelwide. Exact 2025 N/NAAR and M/medical status mapping and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified. Numerical success does not certify counts.

All full and deleted designs have rank two and positive finite scales. Ursula Stephens Elementary / NCES 482517010769 has the highest Cook distance in all three models and stays included. Income extremes and all eligible influential schools remain. Predictions are unbounded; no clamping, shrinkage, weights or fit-based exclusions.

Complete linked original evidence retains all 915 needed records / 35,746 cells and exact omitted CCD ordinal, identity and population inventories with raw digests. Source and numerical audit references preserve raw masks and definitions. Technical provenance and replay details are available in the district guide.

Programs are Unclassified; admissions, provider roles and geography remain unknown. Grade and assessment mixtures, accountable populations, rounded rates, broader fall economic status and omitted prior attainment limit interpretation. State models do not provide a national ranking.
